issues.quote: net income grew 31.1% to $77.7 billion in fiscal 2025 versus $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024
We view the widening gap between revenue and earnings growth as evidence of meaningful operating leverage.
issues.problem: Operating income grew only ~16.6%. Most of the gap between revenue and net income growth comes from non-operating gains (e.g., investment gains on the Anthropic stake), not operating leverage.

data.summary: Most figures and margins check out, but net income growth is miscalculated (~31.3%, not 31.1%), and the operating-leverage conclusion overstates what operating results show, since much of the net income growth came from non-operating gains.
